images.prompt: Generate ONE standalone high-quality photorealistic FRONT full-body e-commerce image of the adult woman wearing the exact red outfit in reference1. Reference1 is authoritative for garment, identity and the unchanged action: both bent elbows down beside torso, both hands together low at upper waist pinching/lifting the shirt hem, slight natural lean/head orientation. Reference2 is an adjustable anatomical mannequin shape/pose guide only, not appearance; prioritize reference1 where they disagree. Preserve red pointelle fine vertical openwork knit, wide shallow round boat neckline, THREE-QUARTER sleeves ending below elbows, tiny red/green neck and waistband trims, red relaxed elastic-waist trousers. Do not invent long tight wrist sleeves, buttons, belt or jacket. Extend the cropped unseen legs as a clearly plausible hypothesis, barefoot, complete head to toes visible with margins on plain pale grey studio background. Same adult face and long dark wavy hair. Natural photographic lighting, sharp knit and hands, realistic five fingers pinching the hem, no A pose, no arms spread. Single portrait image at highest available native resolution, no text, no collage, no panels.

Edit the supplied original e-commerce reference photo into ONE high-quality pose-estimation-style image. Preserve the exact original 1000x1276 crop, person position, body proportions, camera and red garment with small pointelle rib pattern, wide round boat neckline, three-quarter sleeves, and red drawstring trousers. Crucially keep the original action: both elbows bent; both hands low at upper waist pinching/lifting the red shirt hem; both wrists and fingers as in the actual original. Do not spread arms or change to neutral A pose. Show the original photo underneath at muted contrast with clean colored joint points and thin connected skeleton lines precisely aligned to the actual anatomy (shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis; knees/ankles outside frame should not be invented in frame). Include hands small landmark dots and links for the hem-pinching gesture, avoid obscuring the garment. This is an illustrative Image Gen pose guide, not detector ground truth. No panels, no collage, no text labels, one image. Highest available native resolution.
